zh-Hans: 测试游戏文件夹导入、创意画布删除与恢复；尝试工作区视频编辑和代码生成画面。新建 Linux 环境可测试图形及视频加速，已有环境可继续使用原版本。
en-US: Try importing game folders, deleting and restoring creative canvases, editing workspace videos, and generating frames with code. Test graphics and video acceleration in a new Linux environment; existing environments can remain on their current version.
